December 29,2021
TheGeneral Manager
Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited
Stock Exchange Building
Karachi
Subject:
Fauji Foods Limited-CreditofRightSharesinCentral DepositorySystem("CDS")
Dear Sir,
We are pleased to inform you that right shares of Fauji Foods Limited have been credited into respective
accounts/sub-accounts of shareholders maintained with Central Depository Company of Pakistan Limited as
on December 28, 2021. Copy of confirmation letter of CDC confirming credit of 780,753,348 shares is
enclosed herewith for your reference.
The share certificates of those shareholders, who opted for physical shares are in process and willbe ready
Town, Lahore, by surrendering their original paid letter of rights.
Yours Sincerely,
For and onbehalf of Fauji FoodsLimited
awy
